statusDefinitions.supported: The outcome has an executable implementation and automated end-to-end contract coverage.
statusDefinitions.conditional: The outcome is executable only when named model, provider, device, response-shape, or runtime prerequisites are satisfied.
statusDefinitions.limited: A narrower runtime outcome works, but the complete operator journey is not yet proved.
statusDefinitions.blocked: The user outcome is intentionally unavailable and has explicit blockers.

journeys.outcome: Choose the managed Gemini proxy or a compatible local Doppler model, set the first objective and cycle interval, and awaken the CreateTool-only Zero runtime.
prerequisites: The selected proxy endpoint is reachable with the configured model, or the browser and device qualify for the selected Doppler artifact.
limitations: Configuration completeness enables Awaken; a successful provider preflight is not required.
The ordinary browser suite does not prove current managed-endpoint availability or current local model artifact availability.

journeys.outcome: Watch model input, model output, tool execution, runtime state, tokens, cycle count, and failures update while Zero pursues the objective.
prerequisites: A configured inference provider returns a response understood by the agent parser.
The agent loop remains inside its iteration, context, and retry limits.
limitations: Most deterministic cycle coverage uses a mock cognition provider.
The visible trace is capped at 80 entries and is not itself a retained release artifact.
Cycle completion proves execution and audit production, not that an arbitrary objective was solved well.

journeys.outcome: Start with only CreateTool, activate a fixture-tested tool, replay its activation in a fresh harness, load it into the live runner, and use it in a later action.
prerequisites: The model emits a valid CreateTool call and complete module source.
The proposed tool declares deterministic activation checks that pass and replay with matching transcripts.
limitations: Activation proves only the declared fixture contract and replay transcript.
It does not prove the tool is generally correct, secure, or useful outside those fixtures.
Whether a real model authors the needed tool correctly remains model-dependent.

journeys.outcome: Create a capability-bearing self-write tool, preserve rollback evidence, patch a live Zero tool, UI module, or mirrored core module, and activate the result through tool load, UI reload, or document reload.
prerequisites: CreateTool accepts and activates a tool declaring the self:write capability.
The generated self writer preserves rollback and mutation evidence.
The patch remains bootable after activation or reload.
limitations: Zero does not expose Promote; an activated self:write tool can write allowed live mirrors directly.
CreateTool replay validates declared fixtures, not the full application regression suite or a human approval.
The end-to-end self-patch tests drive deterministic tool calls directly rather than proving autonomous patch quality from an open-ended prompt.

journeys.outcome: Queue one context or correction note for the next cycle, stop an active run, cancel a pending provider retry, and manually reload the Zero UI.
prerequisites: The Zero runtime UI is mounted.
A run or retry is active for the stop control to remain enabled.
limitations: Zero has no Run or Resume control after an ordinary user stop.
The current automated UI coverage does not exercise the complete note, stop, cancel-retry, and reload journey through user input.

journeys.outcome: Retain writable VFS files and cycle artifacts across reload, then inspect them after rebuilding the reader capabilities needed by the minimal surface.
prerequisites: IndexedDB and the service worker remain available for the same Zero instance.
Zero has created or recreated a reader tool capable of inspecting the files.
limitations: The minimal Zero UI has no VFS browser, export control, or replay importer.
Persisted created tools are not proved to auto-load into a fresh ToolRunner after reload.
Recovery remains local to one browser instance.

journeys.outcome: Run a bounded Zero mutation cycle with actual Doppler WebGPU cognition and bind model identity, tool calls, cycle audits, and the produced artifact.
prerequisites: Chromium WebGPU and the pinned Doppler model artifact are available.
The hardware-qualified run completes within its bounded test timeout.
limitations: The actual-inference lane is skipped by default.
The prompt supplies an exact desired tool transcript, so this proves the real inference and execution boundary rather than open-ended autonomous design quality.
No immutable deployed artifact from the most recent run is referenced by this registry.

openWork.summary: Persist an actual deployed Zero run as immutable journey evidence instead of relying on transient Playwright attachments or prose.
openWork.acceptance: A retained artifact supplies every releaseEvidence.requiredArtifactFields value and is linked from releaseEvidence.retainedArtifact.

openWork.summary: Measure whether Zero solves representative open-ended objectives rather than only reproducing supplied tool transcripts.
openWork.acceptance: A versioned objective set binds model, prompt, cycle receipts, final artifacts, machine checks, and human usefulness or recognizability verdicts.

openWork.summary: Define and enforce the authority boundary for a dynamically created self:write tool that can bypass X's Promote lane.
openWork.acceptance: The runtime enforces an explicit, tested policy for high-impact live writes, preserves rollback, and cannot self-authorize mutations to the policy or its validators.

openWork.summary: Prevent a syntactically complete but unreachable inference configuration from looking ready.
openWork.acceptance: Awaken readiness distinguishes configured from verified, and tests cover failed proxy and failed local-model preflight with actionable recovery.

openWork.summary: Give Zero a complete, tested operator control loop after a stop.
openWork.acceptance: Browser coverage queues a note, observes it in the next model input, stops, resumes without reloading the page, cancels a retry, and preserves correct button state.

openWork.summary: Make the operator-visible trace recoverable and exportable instead of retaining only a capped in-memory view.
openWork.acceptance: The operator can reopen or export a cycle trace whose rows bind the corresponding VFS cycle artifacts and hashes.

openWork.summary: Prove how a tool created in one Zero session becomes available after a fresh boot.
openWork.acceptance: An end-to-end test creates a tool, reloads without recreating it, safely restores and revalidates it, then executes it with an auditable activation receipt.

openWork.summary: Evaluate generated tools beyond their author-supplied activation fixtures.
openWork.acceptance: Independent hidden fixtures, capability abuse checks, and held-out task checks are bound to the created tool bytes and activation evidence.

constraints: Zero must boot with exactly CreateTool and must not silently inherit X tools or modules.
Activation replay proves declared fixture behavior, not general correctness or safety.
A mock-model browser pass must not be presented as actual inference quality evidence.
A seed or cycle artifact hash proves identity and custody, not that the objective was solved.
Zero live self-mutation claims must disclose that it does not use X's Promote tool.
